g.text: All declared broad-microglia contrasts; positive = left alias higher
WT5/Mut5 is the main-figure pair; WT1/Mut1 is the other-concentration pair. Young−Control is age context only.
These are differences of observed pool means/detection fractions, not the authors’ differential-expression log2 fold changes.
No marker-vector score, favorable-direction aggregation, cell-based P values, or population confidence intervals.
